name: Pal Biz AutoTracker
author: elearningstack

sections.description:
Pal Biz AutoTracker is a powerful WordPress plugin designed for WooCommerce store owners who want to stay on top of their sales performance.

Get comprehensive, automated reports delivered directly to your inbox with detailed information about:

  • 📊 Orders Report – Track all orders (free and paid) with complete order details
  • 👥 User Registrations – Monitor new customer registrations (verified and unverified)
  • 🏪 Category Sales – See which product categories are performing best

Key Features

✅ Automated Report Generation – Set it and forget it with automatic scheduling
✅ Flexible Scheduling – Choose from Daily, Weekly, or Monthly reports
✅ Custom Date Ranges – Generate manual reports for specific date ranges
✅ Multiple Report Types – Orders, Users, and Categories reports
✅ PDF & CSV Formats – Get reports in both formats automatically
✅ Email Customization – Customize email subject and body content
✅ Dynamic Sender Configuration – Set custom sender name and email
✅ Debug Logging – Built-in debug logger for troubleshooting
✅ WooCommerce Integration – Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce
✅ Professional Design – Clean and intuitive admin interface

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Pal Biz AutoTracker
  3. Configure your settings:
    • Enable/disable automatic reports
    • Choose report frequency (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)
    • Select which report types to include
    • Set recipient email addresses
    • Customize email subject and body
    • Configure sender name and email
  4. Set up your schedule and send time
  5. Sit back and receive automated reports!

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher

Support

For support and inquiries, please contact: cs@elearningstack.com

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later. See license.txt for details.

Credits

Developed by ELS for E-Learning Stack (https://elearningstack.com)

Additional Resources

  • Official Website: https://elearningstack.com
  • Support Email: cs@elearningstack.com
  • GitHub: Coming soon

Security

This plugin follows WordPress security best practices:
* Proper capability checks (manage_options)
* AJAX nonce verification
* Input sanitization and validation
* Output escaping with esc_html(), esc_attr(), etc.
* Safe database queries with prepared statements
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins page
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Pal Biz AutoTracker
  4. Configure your settings and enable automatic reports
sections.faq:
Can I customize the email template?

Yes! You can customize both the email subject and body content in the plugin settings. Use placeholders like {week_end_date}, {site_name}, {date_range} to personalize your emails.

What if I want to generate a report for a specific date range?

You can use the “Generate Reports Now” button in the Manual Report Generation section and specify custom start and end dates. This won’t affect your scheduled reports.

How often can I schedule reports?

You can choose from Daily, Weekly, or Monthly reports. For weekly reports, you can select the specific day of the week.

Can I include free orders in the report?

Yes! There’s an option to include or exclude free orders from the Orders report.

What formats are the reports?

Reports are generated in both PDF and CSV formats for maximum flexibility.

Where can I get help?

Please contact us at cs@elearningstack.com for any support needs.
